description:
Make every caller that runs discovery before deriving declarations consume discovery's gate registry, so each captured image resolves its registry once.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/commands/template.rs`: template apply's discovery calls `captured_gates` (~514), and its derivation then calls `declarations_with_config` (~386) without carrying that registry, so the final image resolves its registry twice.
- `6b22ce6d` code-review advisory F1 (2026-11-09). `6b22ce6d` threaded discovery's registry into mutation and precheck bases through `declarations_seeded` / `validation_declarations_seeded`.
- Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-09): in scope under story `d675102c`, since every caller of the discovery path takes the registry from one resolution (`6b22ce6d` ruling 1); same `@/charter/D-20` shape.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-12.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Template apply's derivation takes the registry its discovery resolved for the final image through the `declarations_seeded` pattern.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every other caller of `declarations_with_config` or `validation_declarations_with_config` that runs discovery first is seeded the same way; for any one captured image `captured_gates` runs once, from discovery or from a read path with no discovery.
- [hard] REQ-03: "Template apply resolves the registry once per image" is asserted once: in the owning REQ-12 test if template apply is a gate evaluation input, otherwise as one assertion in the existing parse-once owning test. No per-path test is added.
- [hard] REQ-04: Template output and gate verdicts are unchanged.
title: Every discovery caller consumes discovery's gate registry
